Read retained issue bodies and comments for HEB-184, HEB-178, HEB-127 and HEB-161, plus retained HEX PR metadata. Decoded both GitHub source receipts and independently verified exact equality with installed planning sources; changed-byte controls discriminated.

Read first-failure logs, final validation manifest, candidate-1 validation logs, complete candidate-2 repository log and custody receipt. Retained test overlays were compared mechanically with current modules; unchanged historical test bodies received partial textual reading.
